objective: Predict which actual elements belong to a requested whole instance, keeping native identity and frozen geometry separate
supervision_condition: additional official-training ScanNet 3D instance annotations; not the zero-target-label v8 condition
split_policy: exclude every ScanNet OVS/UQIS evaluation room prefix and all its rescans; fixed room-grouped 80/20 within remaining official training scans

target_semantics.whole_instance: all labelled members of the same instance are positive, distinct labelled instances are negative, unlabelled points are unknown
target_semantics.category_union: other instances of the requested class must also be positive; an instance-negative rule cannot be reused blindly
target_semantics.part: not annotated by these assets; cannot claim part supervision or force whole-object expansion

retained_constraints: Native teacher coordinates and geometry stay frozen
UQIS queries receive no source RGB, source depth or SAM access
One task-typed architecture; no query-name routing or best-old-answer inheritance
Evaluate actual additions/removals, not only the probability map or mask confidence
remaining_inputs: Independent training rooms with real or demonstrably matched teacher observation distributions; rendered-RGB pilot did not transfer actual set quality
Per-instance class mapping for category-union supervision; PLY instance IDs alone are insufficient
Independent whole/part supervision if part claims are pursued

validation_gate.first: Same inputs and budget on room-disjoint mechanism validation; quantify false additions and missed true members
validation_gate.then: Full five-benchmark common-entry rerun before any mainline promotion

results.decision: retain v8; point ranks improve but real UQIS actual selections regress, including equal-count control

latest_followup.decision: retain v8; correct query conditioning but mean set gains unstable and four-query success decreases
